evidenceLayout: tmp/ss-session-20260925-s183/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ holds pre-edit-hashes.txt, intent.md, post-edit-hashes.txt, notes.md and final-hashes.txt (tmp is gitignored). Cargo logs go to target/fe-logs/ss-<wave>-<check>-s<S>-<n>.log per design 6.5.7.
logRule: Design 6.5.7: every run writes a new target/fe-logs/ss-<wave>-<check>-s<S>-<n>.log (S = Riela session number; n counts from 1 per check within the session; never overwrite). Run each command as (set -o pipefail; CMD 2>&1 | tee LOG); echo "exit=$?" >> LOG. The progress log cites the counting log path and its exit= value, and for nextest and cargo test the run and passed counts (run > 0). A missing log, a log without exit=, or a truncated log fails the check. 'LOG(<name>): CMD' in the verification arrays means CMD run under this rule with <name> as the log stem.

commonContract.editProtocol: vactr-session-contracts.md section 'Edit Protocol (common to every SS plan)': fresh read and sha256 before each edit, an intent snapshot before the first edit of any file the plan did not create and of every conditional or shared path, post-edit hash, stop and re-apply on drift, keep the tree compiling, never edit files outside writePaths/sharedPaths, rustfmt on owned files only, no git reset/clean/stash/checkout, no branches or worktrees, no commits, Rust written through the rust-coding agent followed by check-and-test-after-modify, final-hashes.txt at the end.
commonContract.ownershipRule: Design 14.5.3: one writer per file per wave. A file passes between SEQUENTIAL waves only as a CONTRACTS seed or stub filled later: session/mod.rs (CONTRACTS -> SS-SESSION), ns/eval_doc.rs (CONTRACTS -> SS-SESSION), value/sample.rs (CONTRACTS -> SS-ANALYSIS), host/native/tap.rs (CONTRACTS -> SS-ANALYSIS), and the pkg/, directives/, cli/ and lsp/ mod.rs stubs (CONTRACTS -> owner; lsp/mod.rs carries the seeded run_stdio signature used by SS-CLI). Files CONTRACTS may touch conditionally for exhaustive-match arms (sched/runtime.rs, sched/commit.rs, ns/insts.rs, host/native/loader.rs, host/testing.rs, ...) are later owned by exactly one wave-2 plan. Both plans list every handed-off file. No two plans of one wave share a file.
commonContract.gateContract: The step6-implement output payload carries planId and leaves verificationGaps EMPTY when every automated command passed (manual checks go under residualRisks). The test-integrity and adversarial-review outputs carry NO planId; the adversarial-review output always carries a findings array (empty when none) whose items use only findingId, severity, category, file, line, message, evidence. The integration-review output is a plain object carrying needs_revision and loopGate and lists in acceptedPlanIds only plans present in plans[] of this manifest.
commonContract.parallelSafety: Wave 2 (SS-PKG, SS-DIRECTIVES, SS-ANALYSIS) and wave 4 (SS-CLI, SS-LSP) run in the same working directory at the same time with pairwise-disjoint writePaths and no sharedPaths. A build or test error in another plan's in-flight file is recorded as sibling-caused, never fixed by the observer; serial repair happens at the SS-SESSION join and in SS-FINAL.
commonContract.commitPolicy: The source tree stays uncommitted until the workflow commit step. The plan/design checkpoint commit (before fanout) stages by explicit path only: design-docs/specs/design-implementation.md, design-docs/specs/command.md, design-docs/user-qa/pending-session-questions.md, design-docs/user-qa/README.md, impl-plans/active/vactr-session-*.md, impl-plans/active/ss-session-20260925-s183-dispatch.json, impl-plans/README.md. It never stages src/, tests/, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock. The single implementation commit on main uses the six CLAUDE.md sections on separate lines and no AI attribution or Co-Authored-By line; its staging list is in vactr-session-finalize.md. SS-FINAL never edits this manifest.
commonContract.normativeDesign: design-implementation.md 5.7, 13.5, 14, 14.5 and 17 plus command.md are normative. Where a plan and the design differ, the design wins and the difference goes in that plan's progress log.
commonContract.commonVerification: Every plan runs rows V1 build, V1l build-lsp, V2 clippy, V2l clippy-lsp, V3 nextest, V3t plain cargo test, V3f spec fixtures, V6a wasm32, V6b wasm32 host-wasm, V7 fmt --check, V4 line count, V5 std-IO grep, V9 wasm32 dependency tree, as specified in vactr-session-contracts.md.

issueReference.title: Implement the session layer: Session, protocol, packages, directives, REPL, LSP, CLI (TASK-009)

reviewContext.userProblem: TASK-001..008 (commits 0bee1fb, 3ab64b6, 04afe7d) produce a language, scheduler and audio engine, but there is no Session, protocol, package loading, directive machinery, REPL, LSP or CLI: src/main.rs only prints the version (issue #4).
requiredOutcomes: Every TASK-009 completion criterion in impl-plans/active/vactr-core.md is checked with evidence and the task is COMPLETED; the audible REPL gate is recorded as pending user confirmation with the recording-host test as its automated proxy.

Protocol round-trip, reactive bindings publication (all TASK-005 traces), package (MVS, lock, digest portability and injectivity, archive safety, atomic staging, local HTTP proxy fixture), directive (attachment, labels, vocabulary, BindingKey, both persistence modes) and stale-write tests pass.
vactr repl, run <file.vact>, serve and get <path> work against NoopHost; the vactr lsp stdio smoke test passes with --features lsp.
The self-analysis surfaces (scope, spectrum, capture, render, rms, peak) are typed by the checker and callable from the REPL.
design-docs/specs/command.md documents the CLI and protocol (done at design time).
On the final tree: build, build --features lsp, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, fmt --check, nextest, cargo test and both wasm32 builds exit 0.
Per-wave plans are marked Completed and impl-plans/README.md is updated; a single commit on main with the six-section message and no attribution lines.
supportedEdgeCases: Malicious but correctly hashed packages (traversal, absolute path, escaping symlink, case-fold duplicates, over-limit archive): rejected naming the entry, no cache mutation (vactr-session-pkg.md).
An interrupted extraction leaves no partial cache entry (vactr-session-pkg.md cache.rs).
Newline-in-filename digest forgery: rejected by validation, and the canonical bytes differ (vactr-session-pkg.md digest.rs).
Debounce-race writes, edit invalidation, composed change-set mapping, superseded definitions, and a mismatched base revision (vactr-session-core.md authority.rs).
Provisional rollback, late failure and abort/retry never leak provisional values to subscribers or hosts (vactr-session-core.md publish.rs).
Duplicate or ambiguous labels and selectors fall back to positional provenance; reordered same-named sites migrate, and broken mappings are marked stale (vactr-session-directives.md).
A missing audio device falls back to noop with a warning (S6); a socket with a bad token or path gets 401 (vactr-session-cli.md).
Offline render never runs one-shots or mutates the live runtime; the browser tier and builds without host-native report beyond-capability at the call (vactr-session-analysis.md).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: The browser fetch()/OPFS package backend and browser taps (TASK-010).
Slot and :in analyzer sources; fft :src and amp :src forms (S2).
constraints: Implement exactly the TASK-009 deliverables and criteria as pinned by design-implementation.md 14.5.
Files at 800+ lines are split (hard limit 1000); compile/compiler.rs is split in SS-CONTRACTS; ns/evaluator.rs, dsp/engine.rs and dsp/build.rs are not edited.

tungstenite and getrandom are behind host-native, tower-lsp and tokio behind lsp, all in the non-wasm32 target table; serde, serde_json and miniz_oxide are wasm32-clean; both wasm32 builds exit 0 and V9 shows no gated crate.
Cargo runs with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; one complete log per command with exit= recorded; every plan runs plain cargo test besides nextest.
Package fixtures use only a local directory store, a local HTTP fixture and local git repositories; secret-dependent commands run through kinko exec; no secret values are committed.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Session wraps Evaluator + Runtime; the eval pipeline drains per form so later forms see finished captures and renders (14.5.4).
One bindings batch per completed pass is built from the returned PassReport, so mid-pass publication is impossible by construction (14.5.5).
eval carries the full document text and edit_epoch; reconciled epoch per document; the seven authority rules (14.5.6).
A running session never fetches; vactr get is the only native fetch path; validation runs before the digest; staged atomic publication (14.5.7).
AnalysisCx rides on the SourceLoader hook (SourceLoader::analysis), so no new VM field is added (14.5.9; plan-level refinement of 'registered like register_load').
The session socket lives in cli/ws.rs (loopback, 32-byte token, 401, 8 connections, 1 MiB frames) (14.5.10).
intentionalTradeoffs: Waves: CONTRACTS -> {PKG, DIRECTIVES, ANALYSIS} -> SESSION -> {CLI, LSP} -> FINAL, sequenced only where source forces it.
Offline render via headless NativeAudioHost instead of a new Engine::render API.
Plan files are archived in a separate docs commit after the workflow commit, as in issues #2 and #3.
nonGoals: Editor (TASK-010), WebMIDI, WebGL RenderHost, UDP OSC transport, browser package and tap backends.
Native HTTPS proxy client, TLS, non-loopback socket.
decisionsNotToReopen: Scope chain and shadowing, named-argument binding, directive attachment and the 13.5 vocabulary (PROPOSED, tracked), the Go-style package model with MVS / vactr.lock / canonical digest, Q3/Q4, use-clock :link as a diagnostic.
openUserQa: S2 tap sources :master and named buses; fft/amp source forms deferred.
S4 no overlay values in Directive persistence.
S6 native host falls back to noop.
